name: 80122 · Centennial, CO
findings: ZIP 80122 (Centennial) has 131 nonprofit organizations. 62 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 54 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 80122 (Centennial) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
